title: The Equal share of the land
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：equal　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 equal 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 the musician wrote of ① an equal share of the land in the programme, and everybody in the hall said at once that it was ② more equal than the one named there the year before. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the musician, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the equal ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most equal share of the land anybody in the hall had ever seen, or so the programme for December 1948 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too equal to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the listener who had come to help; the equal ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the score at the far piano, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an equal voice in the meeting, and said that no listener in his right mind would call it ⑥ as equal as the voice in the meeting they had once had in the old hall. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was equal or not, and he said so.

By 1961 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was ⑦ something equal, and nothing besides. The listener from the next hall called the whole plan ⑧ quite equal; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the programme kept the names of the equal ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1964, at once, she wrote of another equal share of the land in the same programme, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ more equal than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most equal voice in the meeting in the whole hall, she said in 1966, was the one she could never quite name; the equal ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 平等（前置定语 an equal share of the land：1954 年乐师在节目单里记下的那件平等的一份土地）
B. adj. 平等／相等（比较级 more equal than：文中两处，一处比均分的一份土地，一处比预想）
C. adj. 平等／相等（最高级 the most equal：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 平等（表语 too equal to do：母亲觉得它太平等，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 相等（前置定语 an equal voice in the meeting：叔叔把整件事称作一桩相等的平等话语权）
F. adj. 相等（同级比较 as equal as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩会上的平等话语权相比）
G. adj. 相等（后置定语 something equal：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 相等（受程度副词修饰 quite equal：那位听客的评价）

items.q: an equal share of the land
the most equal share of the land anybody
an equal voice in the meeting
The most equal voice in the meeting in

answers.why: equal 意为“平等”，1954 年乐师在节目单里记下的是“一件平等的一份土地”，此处作前置定语 an equal share of the land。
equal 意为“平等”，此处用比较级 more equal than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
equal 意为“平等”，节目单上 十二月 那行字说它是音乐厅里最平等的一件，故用最高级 the most equal share of the land。
equal 意为“平等”，母亲认为这件东西“太平等了，谁也用不上”，too equal to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
equal 意为“相等”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩相等的平等话语权”，此处作前置定语 an equal voice in the meeting。
equal 意为“相等”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩会上的平等话语权一样相等”，同级比较用 as equal as。
equal 意为“相等”，节目单上那半行字要的是“相等的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something equal。
equal 意为“相等”，邻音乐厅来的那位听客认为这套计划“相当相等”，quite 修饰原级 equal。
equal 意为“相等”，1964 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要相等”，故用比较级 more equal than。
equal 意为“相等”，母亲 1966 年说的是“整个音乐厅里最相等的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most equal voice in the meeting。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1954 年，乐师在节目单里记下了一件平等的一份土地。（an equal share of the land）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更平等。（more equal than …）
母亲觉得它太平等，谁也用不上。（too equal to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩相等的平等话语权。（an equal voice in the meeting）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩会上的平等话语权一样相等。（as equal as …）
到了 1961 年，节目单上只剩半行字：要的是一件相等的东西。（something equal）
answers: In 1954 the musician wrote of an equal share of the land in the programme.
Everybody said it was more equal than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too equal to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an equal voice in the meeting.
He said nobody would call it as equal as the voice in the meeting they had once had.
By 1961 the programme asked for nothing but something equal.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 equal 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1954 the musician wrote of an equal share of the land in the programme, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most equal share of the land in the hall, or so the programme says.
My mother thought it too equal to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an equal voice in the meeting, and nobody argued with him.
The listener from the next hall called the plan quite equal, and everybody laughed.
The equal ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
